name: PHYSKIT-CAPABILITY-DEVELOPMENT
description: Reusable human-gated workflow for bounded PhysKit capability development without selecting a capability.

ownership_model.parent_coordinator: activation, task and active-state coordination, exact ownership assignment, correction routing, parent verification, and human checkpoint presentation
ownership_model.physkit-capability-architect: exact task-owned capability contract and architecture paths only
ownership_model.physkit-implementation: exact task-owned production paths under src/physkit only
ownership_model.physkit-verification: exact task-owned test paths under tests and separately justified evidence-summary paths only
ownership_model.physkit-notebook-documentation: exact task-owned notebook and user-facing documentation paths only
ownership_model.human: all protected scientific, numerical, API, pedagogical, evidence-acceptance, canonical-artifact, lifecycle, final-acceptance, and successor decisions

concurrency_rules.allowed: read-only inspection; deterministic nonmutating checks; or writers with exact nonoverlapping paths and an explicit integration seam
concurrency_rules.forbidden: overlapping writers, verification against partial source, library reconstruction before accepted API implementation, or correction concurrent with affected review
concurrency_rules.stage_7_exception: explicit notebook construction may begin after human contract acceptance when it does not depend on unaccepted implementation behavior and its paths do not overlap other writers

chain.required_decision: Human identifies one bounded capability, learner purpose, intended use, initial exclusions, and authority to draft a contract.

chain.result_required: exact nonoverlapping path ownership, dependencies, checks, handoffs, exclusions, correction routing, and stop rules

chain.content: explicit physical, mathematical, numerical, code, and direct-verification construction without hiding the target behind PhysKit
reconstruct the shared baseline with the accepted PhysKit API and explicitly compare it with Stage 7
multiple cases, parameter sweeps, comparisons, visualization, bounded interpretation, and accurate user documentation

chain.scope_rule: each writer remains within unchanged exact ownership; no concurrent overlapping corrections

chain.rule: replay every affected deterministic and evidence-producing check without changing accepted tolerances

chain.lifecycle_promotion: outside this chain unless separately human-authorized
